records.section: Grade 4 — content + the game "Syntaxia" / The game: "Syntaxia" (designed, not built)
records.requirementOrFinding: Each of the 13 grammar structures becomes a themed **portal-world**; mastering the structure re-seals the world. The design adds three things beyond the other games' pattern: **real branching** (choice graphs, VS-5-proven dead-end-free — already free in the engine), a **party / hint-economy** (companions unlock by clearing worlds = *derived* from solved items; spendable "Ink" is *cosmetic* and buys scaffolds, never answers), and **boss battles** per world. An optional Three.js "Fog Gate" 3D set-piece is a forfeit-first stretch.
